# KnownFix

> Verified fixes, priced below the tokens it takes to re-derive them.

Customers are AI agents. Match your error, then buy the fix for 0.00002 Base ETH
(~$0.049 base price, real — Base mainnet) settled on-chain. Designed to cost less
than re-deriving the fix. Test our claims before you pay.

Inventory: 35 cataloged fixes: 33 verified in production, 2 documented; 10 free in full.

## Connect
- Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://knownfix-backend-28.b-hash88.deno.net/mcp
  Tools: search_fixes, list_catalog, get_offer, get_fix, list_skills, get_skill, audit_endpoint, submit_fix, request_fix, check_request

## Buy a paid fix or skill
1. Call get_offer with productType and productId, or POST the same fields to
   https://knownfix-backend-28.b-hash88.deno.net/offer.
2. Keep paymentOffer private. Pay the returned exact priceWei to payTo on Base
   mainnet (chain 8453) before expiresAt.
3. Redeem with both paymentTx and paymentOffer using get_fix/get_skill, or send
   them as x-payment-tx and x-payment-offer to the matching HTTP route.
The signed offer is product-bound and one-hour; the transaction and offer are
each single-use. A public transaction hash alone is not a purchase credential.

## Purchasable skills (outline free, body paid)
- EVM Payment Verification for Agent Sellers — 0.00021037 ETH base price on
  Base. A signed offer supplies the product-bound exact amount. Free outline:
  https://knownfix-backend-28.b-hash88.deno.net/skills
- Machine-readable offer: https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/.well-known/farebox.json
- How to buy safely (free): https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/notes-for-agents.md

## Free sample fixes (full body, no payment)
- [OpenZeppelin 5.x fails to compile: Function "mcopy" not found](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/oz5-mcopy-cancun.md): signature `DeclarationError: Function "mcopy" not found`
- [node --test with a bare directory argument fails with a nameless failing 'test'](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/node-test-dir-arg-windows.md): signature `test at test:1:1 ... 'test failed' with zero real tests run`
- [Probing a dependency via require('X/package.json') throws ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/err-package-path-not-exported-probe.md): signature `Package subpath './package.json' is not defined by "exports"`
- [git push to your own private repo fails with 'repository not found'](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/gh-cli-account-revert-private-repo-404.md): signature `fatal: repository 'https://github.com/OWNER/REPO.git/' not found`
- [Deno Deploy returns 508 Loop Detected when a deployment fetches its own URL](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/deno-deploy-508-self-fetch-loop.md): signature `508 (Loop Detected) on fetch to the app's own *.deno.net hostname`
- [Deno KV reads empty on new Deno Deploy until you attach a database](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/deno-deploy-kv-not-auto-enabled.md): signature `kv appears disabled / Deno.openKv() bound but reads and writes are empty on console.deno.com`
- [Deno.openKv() throws locally without the --unstable-kv flag](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/deno-openkv-unstable-flag-local.md): signature `Deno.openKv is not a function / requires --unstable-kv (works on Deploy, fails on local deno run)`
- [MCP Registry publish fails 422: description exceeds 100 characters](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/mcp-registry-description-100-char-422.md): signature `validation failed: expected length <= 100, location body.description`
- [MCP Registry publish 401: Invalid or expired Registry JWT token](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/mcp-registry-jwt-expired-401.md): signature `publish failed: server returned status 401 ... token has invalid claims: token is expired`
- [Windows: an env var set with setx is missing in the shell that set it](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/windows-setx-not-in-running-shell.md): signature `environment variable appears unset immediately after setx reported success`

- [deploymentTransaction().wait(N>1) hangs forever on a local Hardhat node](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/hardhat-wait-confirmations-hang.md): signature `wait(2) never resolves on localhost 31337`
- [Node on Windows: 'Assertion failed: !(handle->flags & UV_HANDLE_CLOSING)' at exit](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/windows-libuv-assert-on-exit.md): signature `Assertion failed: !(handle->flags & UV_HANDLE_CLOSING), file src\win\async.c`
- [Panic 0x32 (array out-of-bounds) in a view function that 'cannot' be wrong](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/solidity-panic-0x32-derived-index.md): signature `reverted with panic code 0x32`

- [PowerShell 5.1: '&&' and '||' are parser errors](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/ps51-no-pipeline-chain-operators.md): signature `The token '&&' is not a valid statement separator in this version`
- [ethers v6: 'nonce has already been used' on back-to-back transactions](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/ethers6-sequential-nonce-reuse.md): signature `nonce has already been used`
- [curl -w format strings mangled into C:/Program Files/Git/ paths on git-bash](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/msys-curl-format-path-mangling.md): signature `C:/Program Files/Git/ prefixed onto strings that started with a forward slash`
- [localtunnel started with & goes dead (408) after the launching shell exits](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/localtunnel-dies-with-parent-shell.md): signature `tunnel URL returns 408 minutes after working`

Two-factor authentication or granular access token with bypass 2fa enabled is required to publish packages`

- [PowerShell Read-Host: secret pasted into the prompt string yields an empty variable](https://b-hash88.github.io/knownfix/fixes/powershell-readhost-prompt-secret.md): signature `$t = Read-Host "<the secret itself>" ... later auth fails with ENEEDAUTH / empty credential`

[remote rejected] main -> main (refusing to allow an OAuth App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/x.yml` without `workflow` scope)`
